kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem validate-normalization-rule --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1733260000000 --data 123456 --normalization-category-id NETWORK_CATEGORY --normalization-schema-id HTTP_ACTIVITY --vendor-id alibaba_cloud --product-id alibaba_cloud_sas --extend-field-store-mode flat --normalization-rule-mode realtime --log-sample aaa_:_bbb_,_xxx_:_yyy --normalization-rule-expression 0 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ValidateNormalizationRule

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center of Threat Analysis is located. Select the region of the management center based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: The assets are located in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: The assets are located outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response message. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English.

Note: This parameter is required in actual API calls. If this parameter is not provided, the service returns a 400 error with the message 'The specified Lang can not be empty.' Explicitly specify the language code
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文。

注意：此参数在实际调用中为必填项；未提供时服务返回 400 错误 “The specified Lang can not be empty.”，请显式传入语言代码
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user whose perspective the administrator switches to
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en: The normalization category to which the rule belongs
parameters.name: normalization_category_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the normalization schema to which the rule belongs. This parameter is required in actual API calls. If this parameter is not provided, the service returns a 400 error
parameters.help_zh: 规则所属标准化模式ID。此参数实际为必填项；未提供时服务返回 400 错误
parameters.name: normalization_schema_id

parameters.help_en: The storage mode of extended fields. Valid values: flat, pack, and reject
parameters.help_zh: 扩展字段存储模式，取值：flat、pack、reject
parameters.name: extend_field_store_mode

parameters.help_en: The mode of the normalization rule. Valid values: both and realtime
parameters.name: normalization_rule_mode

parameters.help_en: The log sample in JSON format
parameters.name: log_sample

parameters.help_en: The expression of the normalization rule
parameters.name: normalization_rule_expression

LogFieldName.description_en: The name of the log field

LogFieldValue.description_en: The value of the log field

Message.description_en:
The reason for the validation result. Valid values:
OperationDenied.TheValueIsRequired: A required parameter is empty.
OperationDenied.TheValueIsNull: The parameter value is null.
OperationDenied.TheEnumValueNotSupport: The field value is not within the valid enum values.
OperationDenied.TheValueLessThanMin: The field value is less than the specified minimum value.
OperationDenied.TheValueMoreThanMax: The field value is greater than the specified maximum value.
OperationDenied.TheValueNotMatchRegularExpression: The field value fails the regular expression match.
success: The validation is passed
Message.description_zh:
校验原因，取值：
OperationDenied.TheValueIsRequired： 必填参数为空。
OperationDenied.TheValueIsNull:  参数值为空。
OperationDenied.TheEnumValueNotSupport： 字段值不在枚举值范围内。
OperationDenied.TheValueLessThanMin：  字段值小于设定的最小值。
OperationDenied.TheValueMoreThanMax： 字段值大于设定的最大值。
OperationDenied.TheValueNotMatchRegularExpression： 字段值正则匹配不通过。
success： 验证通过
